decision_summary: Approve the QIF pre-implementation review and negative acceptance guidance as a docs-only v0.3.1 candidate.
rationale: The slice operationalizes cross-project feedback by adding prevention-oriented QIF guidance before implementation, extending Discovery Patterns for solution bias, data boundary confusion, and concept comprehension, and preserving QIF as a standalone representation and evaluation framework.
recommendation: Keep this as a documentation and design hardening commit; implement executable schemas, examples, verifier rules, release, and tag only in later explicit slices.
target_audience: QIF maintainers, AI agents, and human reviewers using QIF before implementation
expected_user_reaction: They can use QIF to review proposed changes before building without mistaking prompts or negative criteria for checklist completion.
artifact_change_recommendations: If this guidance becomes executable, model negative acceptance as loss-boundary evidence and keep discovery pattern coverage exploratory.
organization_change_recommendations: Use pre-implementation QIF review before UI, process, or data-boundary changes that can encode mistaken assumptions.
